summary: Prefix-only X0 classification could suppress a legitimate manufacturer SKU.
claim: Narrowing the prefix was necessary, but shape must remain candidate evidence rather than verified identity.
suggested_remediation: Use one ambiguity-safe predicate across local decoded values and AI SKU claims; preserve exact evidence and require user confirmation.
suggested_validation: Cover known X00-shaped Code 128, QR, AI-only candidates, and a noncandidate X0 manufacturer SKU.
